subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: After glob parity is repaired, should ordered `agent:bootstrap` handlers intentionally yield to unrelated event-loop work while mutating one shared bootstrap context?
rationale: Source and tests establish registration order and final context values, but only the runtime owner can define whether this lifecycle phase may be cooperatively interleaved between handlers.

options.title: Allow cooperative interleaving
options.body: Keep the between-handler yields and explicitly treat handler order, rather than whole-chain atomicity, as the supported contract.

options.title: Keep bootstrap atomic
options.body: Remove between-handler yields and limit this PR to asynchronous file reads, cooperative glob traversal, and diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Allow cooperative interleaving
recommendation.body: Keep the between-handler yields and explicitly treat handler order, rather than whole-chain atomicity, as the supported contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged-history trail covers bootstrap hook introduction, centralized bootstrap resolution, and the embedded-run integration boundary.
